THROW-FORWARD: Lowveld Hijacked

By: Laura Byrne | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Illegal mining like you've never seen it before.

Unique Selling Point:
Visiting the lowveld to follow up on reports of zama zamas operating in and around Pilgrim's Rest, we uncover illegal mining on a scale that has to be seen to be believed.

Summary:
Illegal mining has become an all-too-familiar story around South Africa, with zama zamas moving into residential areas and even digging underneath the Johannesburg CBD. But when our team travelled to Pilgrim's Rest to investigate reports of zama zamas threatening tourism in the heritage town, we had no idea of the scale of what we would find. The entire Lowveld, from Pilgrim's Rest to Barberton, has been hijacked by illegal mining operations. And on this scale, that means organised crime, as syndicates move in with firearms and explosives. And the impact on local communities is dire: from violent crime, to the destruction of the forestry industry, local agriculture, and the tourism on which this region depends.

Script:


UPSOUND: Rules of engagement: only shoot when shot at. Ok, move out.
LINK: This area’s called Gold Reef City because there’s a gold processing illegal facility here.
UPSOUND: Come on, let’s move! Entering the camp.
VOICEOVER: Pilgrim’s Rest: it’s a historic mining town in the heart of the lowveld. But its mining days aren’t over.
UPSOUND: How much further?
VOICEOVER: In fact, it’s the site of a modern-day gold rush…
UPSOUND: The mercury collects the gold, then you pick the gold pieces out.
VOICEOVER: …feeding an illicit gold trade worth millions.
UPSOUND: Maybe plus minus R20 000 for me and we’re a syndicate, you see.
VOICEOVER: In an upcoming episode of Carte Blanche…
UPSOUND: Don’t be scared mama, come through.
VOICEOVER: We travel from Pilgrim’s Rest to Barberton to investigate reports of zama zamas operating in Mpumalanga…
UPSOUND: You see here, you can see [the gold] more clearly.
VOICEOVER: … and find illegal mining…
UPSOUND: Hide yourself!
- No I’m busy.
- Ok, then cover your face. Cover your face.
VOICEOVER: …on a scale that has to be seen to be believed.
UPSOUND: …like veins going underground…
VOICEOVER: As miners take over old tunnels…
UPSOUND: Wow wow wow, that is deep!
VOICEOVER: And dig new ones, tourism and industry suffer…
UPSOUND: The zama zamas are getting away with the amount of mining they do on our land – land we don’t have access to anymore…
VOICEOVER: …and communities live in fear.
UPSOUND: It has destroyed a lot of lives. The community is not safe, they don’t know who to trust.
VOICEOVER: Take a glimpse into the secretive and dangerous world spreading underneath the hills of the Lowveld.
LINK: Oh my gosh, it’s crazy down there.
UPSOUND: There’s always someone watching here, always.
